comment: The acceptance vectors of the vcard guest (app/specs/guests, app/src/PrismVcard): RFC 6350 and RFC 9555 example lines with how RFC 6350 reads them (test/oracle/vcard.json); two of RFC 6350's own cards split from one file; and cards written from RFC 6350's own FN, EMAIL and TEL values, escaped per 3.4 and folded per 3.2.
